description: Repaint this north-western corner as one continuous frozen landscape seen from above: grey snow-capped mountains and glacier flowing into pale white pack-ice with a few teal open-water leads, easing toward snowy forested slopes at the lower right. Remove the straight vertical and horizontal boundary lines and any speckled noise; nothing straight or stippled should remain. Keep the same white, grey, teal and dark-green palette and the same pixel-art style as the surroundings.
